Welcome to GambVet Clinic, a professional veterinary channel sharing real clinical cases, home visits, and ethical animal treatments from The Gambia.

This channel is run by a licensed veterinarian and focuses on:
• Mangoworm (maggot) removal & parasite treatments
• Puppy and dog emergency care
• Veterinary home visits & field cases
• Preventive care, vaccinations & recovery updates
• Educational insights into animal health and welfare

All procedures are performed with animal safety, hygiene, and welfare as the top priority.
Content is presented for educational and awareness purposes, showing how veterinary medicine improves animal lives in real-world conditions.

📍 Location: Kololi, The Gambia
🏥 Clinic: GambVet Veterinary Services
📞 Appointments & Home Visits: +220 2592060

Thank you for supporting responsible veterinary care and animal welfare.
